Candidates are advised to thoroughly study the Government Order and instructions available on the website before applying to avoid any loss due to errors. content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The District Programme Officer, Firozabad has released the official notification for the recruitment of 101 Anganwadi Karyakatri (Honorarium-based) posts under various Child Development Projects in Firozabad district, Uttar Pradesh. The notification contains complete details regarding eligibility criteria, project-wise vacancies, educational qualification, age limit, selection process, required documents, important instructions, and the online application procedure. Eligible female candidates can submit their applications online through the official website before the last date. content_sections.heading: Firozabad Anganwadi Vacancy Details 2026 (Project-Wise)
content_sections.text: The 101 vacancies are distributed across 5 Bal Vikas Pariyojanas (Child Development Projects) in Firozabad district, covering both rural and urban areas. The category-wise breakup is as follows: Note: The notification states that the number of vacancies displayed on the website may increase or decrease. A separate Scheduled Tribe (ST) column was not listed in the vacancy table provided in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026- Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the ward (urban area) or Gram Panchayat (rural area) corresponding to the vacant post. The residence certificate issued by the Tehsil must mention the Gram Panchayat/village name, or in urban areas, the ward name along with the mohalla name. All selection procedures and terms will follow Government Order No. I/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. A candidate whose family already has one woman appointed as Anganwadi Karyakatri or Anganwadi Sahayika at the same Anganwadi centre will not be appointed to the other post at that same centre. If a selected candidate holds an elected public post (Gram Sabha member, Gram Pradhan, Kshetra Panchayat member, Kshetra Panchayat Adhyaksha, Nagar Palika member, Sabhasad/Parshad, Mahapaur, etc.), she must resign from that post before joining as Anganwadi Karyakatri; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of selection.

content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 - Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Minimum Qualification: Intermediate (12th pass) or equivalent Maximum Qualification considered for merit: Postgraduate Merit list will be prepared based on educational qualification, from minimum Intermediate to maximum Postgraduate level.

content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention a specific monthly salary or honorarium amount for the post of Anganwadi Karyakatri. The post is described as honorarium-based (मानदेय पर आधारित). Candidates are advised to refer to the full Government Order dated 17.09.2025, available on upanganwadibharti.in, or contact the concerned Bal Vikas Pariyojana Adhikari (Child Development Project Officer) office for the exact honorarium details.

content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made purely on the basis of a merit list prepared from educational qualifications (Intermediate as minimum to Postgraduate as maximum). No written examination or interview process is mentioned in the official notification. Preference in selection will be given, as per the order of priority specified in the Government Order, to candidates who are: Widows Divorced women Living below the poverty line (BPL) For widow candidates, the husband's death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer, or the concerned Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad/Nagar Nigam, along with a certified copy of the family register, will be accepted as valid proof. For divorced/deserted women, only an order issued by a competent court will be accepted as valid proof.

content_sections.heading: Firozabad UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Latest self-attested photograph Self-attested signature High School marksheet/certificate (for age proof) Educational qualification certificates (Intermediate to Postgraduate, as applicable) Residence certificate issued by the Tehsil, clearly mentioning Gram Panchayat/village name or ward and mohalla name (for urban areas) Caste certificate (online certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Officer/Tehsildar level, verifiable on the e-District portal) Income certificate (online certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Officer/Tehsildar level, verifiable on the e-District portal, as per the applicable income limits under the relevant Samaj Kalyan and Rajasva Anubhag Government Orders) Death certificate of husband and certified family register copy (for widow candidates, if claiming preference) Competent court order (for divorced/deserted candidates, if claiming preference) All other self-attested documents as specified in the online application form Note: All uploaded documents/photos must be clear and legible. If any document mentioned in the application form is not uploaded, the application will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many Anganwadi Karyakatri vacancies are there in Firozabad in 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 101 vacant posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri across 5 Bal Vikas Pariyojanas in Firozabad district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Firozabad Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 13 August 2026, till midnight 12:00.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post in Firozabad?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned ward or Gram Panchayat, aged between 18 and 35 years as on 1 July 2026, with a minimum qualification of Intermediate, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or equivalent, and merit is prepared up to a maximum of Postgraduate qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Firozabad Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years as on 1 July 2026. No age relaxation is given to any category.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Firozabad Anganwadi Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through the official website upanganwadibharti.in. Offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, the notification clearly states that no separate age relaxation will be given to candidates of Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Class, or General category.

faq.question: Q8. Do widow or divorced candidates get any preference?
faq.answer: Yes, widows, divorced women, and candidates living below the poverty line are given preference in selection as per the order specified in the Government Order, subject to submission of valid supporting documents.
